tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las: sngon du 'gro ba'i chos spyod yan lag bdun pa: sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig 'phrul gyi snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so: :

na mo gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī hūm̐: bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las: yan lag dang po'i chos spyod ni: 'di ltar rnal 'byor pas shes bya: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs: yi dam zhi khro dhā ki chos skyong dang: bka' srung dam can pho mor bcas pa kun: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rnam dag dbyings nas gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang: khams gsum srid gsum 'gro drug 'dren slad du: bde chen yangs pa'i pho brang chen po 'dir: thugs rjes yud tsam gcig gis gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: thabs shes dri med nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: lhod 'bol dar zab rin chen brtsegs pa'i khri: spyi gtsug bde chen dag pa'i gdan steng du: 'gro ba'i don du brtan par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lus kyis dwangs bas spyi bor thal sbyar zhing: bde mnyen 'khyug bcas ma lnga sa la phab: 'greng ldang ldan pa'i gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: rtsa gsum sku yi gzi mdangs lus la phob: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ngag snyan 'gyur dbyangs gus par ldan pa yis: sku gsung thugs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang: mdzad pa'i phrin las brjod bcas phyag 'tshal lo: 'gag med gsung gi byin brlab ngag la stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lhag bsam rnam dag gdung shugs ldan pa yis: dus gsum bder gshegs rtsa gsum yon tan rnams: skad cig dran rdzogs bsam pas phyag 'tshal lo: bde gsal mi rtogs yid la bskyed du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lhan cig skyes sbyor me tog bdug spos dang: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i sgra: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: lus ngag yid gus ldan pas 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gling bzhi gling phran ri rab ri bdun dang: rol mtsho nyi zla skar phran 'bab chur bcas: lteng ka ko mog yan lag brgyad ldan kun: mchod par 'bul gyis 'gro ba'i don du bzhes: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gser dngul g.yu dang mar gad in+d+ra rnyil:

mu tig pad+ma rā ga rdo yi snying: bai ḍūr+ya dang man shel bye ru sogs: rat+na'i rigs 'bul thugs rjes bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ga pur tsan+dan gur gum si la dang: dza ti rnam rgyal snying po zho sha'i tshogs: nyon mongs nad 'joms sman gyi rigs rnams kun: sgo gsum mos blos rtsa ba gsum la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gro 'bras khre dang so ba yungs dkar dang: til nas sran mar bcas te 'bru yi rigs: lhag pa'i bsam pas nye bar 'bul lags na: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla ma yi dam zhi khro dhā ki yi: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun: rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐: srog bcad ma byin blang dang mi tshang spyod: rdzun tshig phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal dbyen: brnab sems gnod sems log par lta la sogs: mi dge bcu po bgyis rnams mthol lo bshags: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzhan yang bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams kyis ni: 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du: lus ngag yid kyis mi dge ci bgyis pa: mthol zhing bshags nas slan chad mi bgyid sdom: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dus gsum 'phags pa'i dge ba bgyis pa ni: zag bcas zag med bgyis dang bgyid brtsal ba: bgyid 'gyur gang yin de dag thams cad la: bdag sogs dwangs bas rjes su yi rang ngo: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba sras bcas dang: sa bcu'i dbang phyug 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyis: phyi nang bla med theg chen chos 'khor lo: 'khor ba ma stongs bar du bskor bar skul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de dag mkha' klong yangs pa'i ngang nyid las: thugs rje'i zer ldan smon 'jug ldan pa po: sdug bsngal 'dam du bying rnams bskyab slad du: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de ltar phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags: dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul:

mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: de dag thams cad byang chub chen por bsngo: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de ltar sgo gsum dwangs bas dus drug tu: yan lag bdun sogs dge ba bgyis pa dang: bgyid 'gyur bgyid par gyur pa'i bsod nams kyis: 'gro drug sems can thar lam bgrod par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnas skabs su yang yul ris rgyal khams su: bkra shis bde legs dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs: dkar po dge ba'i phyogs rnams dar nas kyang: 'gro rnams theg chen chos la spyod par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de yi rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa yis: nag po bdud kyi phyogs rnams pham pa dang: nyes dgu zhi zhing legs dgu dar nas kyang: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: khyad par theg chen chos rnams spyod pa'i tshe: bka' srung rnams kyis ru nga mi bgyid cing: mthu dpal ldan pa'i dge bsnyen khyed rnams kyis: chos byed sgrub pa po yi grogs mgon gyis: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni: dmigs bcas dmigs med zung 'jug ci bsags pa: bla med rdo rje theg par bsngo bar bgyi: 'gro drug rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog: e ma ho: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan pho mo rnams: thun mgo 'am ni nyin mtshan dus drug tu: dam chos ston pa'i tshe na 'di bzlas shing: bsam gtan dang pos rtag tu dran gyur na: dge ba de yi bsod nams ci mchis pa: sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan rdzogs pa dang: sa lam rim gyis bgrod nas theg chen sar: bla med rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang bgrod: gnas skabs su yang shes rab phun tshogs shing: mi brjed gzungs thob ci bsam chos bzhin 'grub: de yi phyir na phyi rabs skal ldan kun: 'di la 'bad rtsol ldan pas nyams su longs: snying po lon nas gzhan la ston zhing spel: sgo 'byed 'phrul gyi lde mig 'phrul gyi snying po zhes bya ba:

o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis phyi rabs kyi don du mdzad pa 'di: mtsho rgyal bdag gis zin bris su btab nas gter du sbas: skyes bu las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: pu ri phug mo che nas bdag 'dra sangs rgyas gling pas bton pa'o// //
